description.value: Ford's Cove is a marina and resort on Hornby Island combining a convenience store and pizzeria with waterfront cottages and a campground. As one of the few service points on this remote Gulf Island, it functions as a key resupply and rest stop for cyclists making the ferry crossing. The property is open year-round with ocean views of Vancouver Island's mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ford's Cove is a real, open, year-round marina/resort complex on Hornby Island that includes a store and pizza operation ('Store & Pizza 250-335-2169'). The OSM name captures the store/pizzeria sub-component of this larger property. The phone 250-335-2169 appears on the website but was absent from OSM tags. Campground amenities (flush toilets, hot showers, outdoor sinks, certified drinking water) are described but in the context of registered campers, so they cannot be confirmed as available to drop-in store customers.
